about: tabs split their box into one row of cells by the cumulative cell formula, each drawn like a button: an empty box, text centred; the value cell is filled with paper text, or from 2.16 outlined 3 px or underlined by a 4 px bar min(8, w // 6) in from its sides, and its text is bold unless bold is set; the focus frame never fills; a tap on another cell returns change and on the value cell activate, the gap between cells hits nothing (cell edges, selected styles and the events probe-confirmed; keys move cell by cell)
